html:
The Yahooskin are a band of Northern Paiute people from the high desert of south central Oregon, around Summer Lake and Silver Lake. Like other Northern Paiute, they moved with the seasons to fish, hunt, and gather seeds and roots in the dry basins.

In the treaty of 1864 they were placed on the Klamath reservation with the Klamath and Modoc, peoples who had long been their rivals. The three now form the Klamath Tribes. The United States ended its recognition of the Klamath Tribes in 1954, under its termination policy, and restored it in 1986.
